home.hero_desc: RasaLens is an integrated academic artificial intelligence platform that performs fine-tuned Named Entity Recognition, Course Classification, Market Basket Association Mining, and FAISS-powered Semantic Retrieval over a verified 13,296 recipe corpus.
home.quick_search_placeholder: Try: '2 cups tomato, onion and garlic' or 'creamy paneer curry'...
home.capabilities_desc: Explore the 6 core natural language processing modules built into RasaLens.

studio.title: Analyze Studio
studio.subtitle: Supply dynamic typed sentences, ingredient chips, or files. The pipeline extracts entities, predicts course & cuisine, runs Market Basket associations, and grounds answers in semantic recipe knowledge.
studio.textarea_placeholder: e.g., I have two ripe tomatoes, 1 cup basmati rice, some paneer and chopped onions. What can I cook?
studio.text_hint: Supports natural quantities, units, and bilingual Tamil queries.
studio.try_tamil: + Try Tamil example: தக்காளி, வெங்காயம், பன்னீர்
studio.chips_empty: No chips selected. Click presets or add ingredients below.
studio.file_drag: Upload a recipe or ingredient list text file
studio.target_pipeline: Target pipeline: spaCy NER + LinearSVC + mlxtend + FAISS
studio.ner_desc: Entities extracted with token boundaries from working query
studio.ner_empty: No structured entities extracted from input.
studio.mba_desc: Affinity recommendations discovered via Apriori & FP-Growth
studio.mba_empty: No association rules exceeded the minimum support and lift thresholds for these items.
studio.rec_desc: Dense vector search across 13,296 recipes with cooking times and chef video alignment
studio.rec_empty: No semantic recipe matches found for this ingredient set.
studio.grounded_desc: Retrieval-grounded summary generated directly from top recipe instructions

assistant.title: Culinary Recipe Assistant
assistant.subtitle: Interactive semantic question answering powered by local FAISS vector search across 13,296 recipes.
assistant.input_placeholder: Ask a recipe question (e.g. 'How do I make creamy garlic pasta?' or 'Quick vegetarian breakfast')...
assistant.sample_1: How do I make authentic vegetable biryani?
assistant.sample_2: Quick high-protein breakfast with eggs and spinach
assistant.sample_3: Creamy garlic parmesan pasta in under 25 minutes
assistant.sample_4: What is the capital of France?
assistant.no_answer_desc: The highest similarity score for this query is below our confidence threshold (0.40). The RasaLens corpus is specialized in culinary recipes and cannot answer out-of-domain queries.

graph.title: Interactive Ingredient Association Network
graph.subtitle: Force-directed graph of ingredient co-occurrences sized by frequency, with edge thickness and tension weighted by association lift.
graph.hover_hint: Hover over a node or link to inspect support, confidence, and lift metrics.

recipes_page.title: Recipe Corpus Explorer
recipes_page.subtitle: Search 13,296 authentic culinary recipes across courses, cuisines, and diets.
recipes_page.search_placeholder: Search by recipe title or ingredients (e.g. 'pesto chicken', 'masala dosa')...
recipes_page.no_recipes: No recipes found matching your filters. Try clearing some search criteria.

footer.brand_desc: Academic Machine Learning & Multi-Modal Culinary NLP Platform
